comments: The title, author and script match those of No. 15557 in [8H6M69W4], but the catalogue reports 160 folios, and [S635TW6P]: 82 reports 155 folios, whereas the reproduction in [Z5AUD7GQ] has 156 folios. The number on the last two folios is not visible. In the set of images in [WD872RQ5], the number "160" has been written over the faded and partly damaged folio number written in letters. It has not been determined whether folios are missing between fol. 154, the next folio, and the folio ending with the colophon.
